title: Ledger account activity event
description: The value of one record on the ledger.account-activity topic: what one account saw happen in one ledger entry. Derived from com.baran.ledger.domain.AccountActivityEvent under a snake_case naming strategy. The event id lives in the event-id record header, not here; see contracts/README.md.

transaction_id.description: public_id of the ledger transaction this entry belongs to. Two records of one transfer carry the same value; it is what a PSP settlement line echoes back.

account_id.description: public_id of the account posted to. Equals the record key, and is the only account attribute on the wire, so source mapping is by this value.

amount.description: Signed minor units (kurus). Negative on the account debited, positive on the account credited. The bounds mirror the amount_bounded CHECK and the exclusion of zero mirrors amount_nonzero.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code of the account posted to. Structural only: which codes this service accepts is configuration, not part of the wire contract. The ledger is single-currency and emits TRY.

tx_type.description: The transaction type, as the producer's enum name. The ledger's CHECK constraint also admits FEE and ADJUSTMENT, but no code can write them today; an event carrying one is contract drift and belongs in the dead-letter topic.

$comment: Unknown properties are allowed on purpose: the payload carries no schema version, so an additive ledger change would otherwise fail every event at once and take the projection down. A missing or malformed known field still fails.

uuid.$comment: A pattern rather than "format": "uuid", because format is an annotation in draft 2020-12 and only asserts when a validator is configured for it. The pattern fails the same input everywhere.
